sections.title: Shared Task Description and Dataset
sections.extract: The LLMs4Subjects shared task challenged partic- ipants to develop LLM-based systems for recom- mending relevant subjects from the GND taxonomy to annotate TIB technical records. Given a record’s title and abstract as input, systems were expected to generate a customizable top-k ranked list of rel- evant GND subjects. sections.title: Shared Task Leaderboard Results
sections.extract: In this shared task, we provided two leaderboards: 1) quantitative results and 2) qualitative results. Quantitative Metrics. System performance was evaluated using average precision@k, recall@k, and F1-score@k at multiple cutoffs (k = 5, 10, 15, ..., 50). These metrics were chosen as sub- ject tagging was treated as a bag-of-words among applicable subjects, making precision, recall, and F1-score more suitable. Given

sections.title: Quantitative Evaluations
sections.extract: The primary evaluation metric was recall, with the overall leaderboard ranking based on average recall scores across k values from 5 to 50. For practical use by subject specialists, systems should predict relevant subjects at lower k values, ideally between 5 and 10, with a maximum of 20. sections.title: Conclusion
sections.extract: SemEval-2025 Task 5: LLMs4Subjects presented the first evaluation of LLMs for GND-based sub- ject indexing in bilingual (German/English) techni- cal library records, combining quantitative metrics with expert assessments.
